SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.School Code = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND s.County = 'Fresno';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Zip 
FROM frpm AS T1 
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno' AND T2.SOCType = 'K-12 Schools (Public)';

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno' AND s.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education' AND s.Charter = 1;
